ayahs.translation: Marka arlada la gilgilo gilgilashadeeda daran (Qiyaamada).
Oo arladu soo bixiso culeysyadeeda (wixii ku aasnaa),

ayahs.arabic_text: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
ayahs.translation: Maalintaas dadku wuxuu u soo dareeri rac rac si loo tusiyo 'jazaha' acmaashooda.

ayahs.arabic_text: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Ee qofkii fala samaan le’eg saxar wuu arki,

ayahs.arabic_text: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Qofkii falana xumaan le’eg saxar wuu arki.
